> **v3.91 UPDATE (2026-08-28, kaizen — CMD SKILLS UPDATE: model-key DB root-source + D1 Bearer fallback — MODEL-KEY-DB-ROOT-SOURCE-1 + D1-QUERY-BEARER-FALLBACK-1; mirrors kaizen v2.111 + cloudflare v3.67 + qnfo-core v1.36 + research v2.143 unchanged):**
> Red-team: direct parent-agent closeout audit (session this — the v3.90 weekly-review triage cycle + CMD CLOSEOUT; reviewer children per REDTEAM-QUEUE-STALL-PATIENCE-1). HARD: 2 (new gates). Changes:
> (1) [HARD] **MODEL-KEY-DB-ROOT-SOURCE-1** (extends DEEPCHAT-DEFAULT-MODEL-1 + MODEL-KEY-FILE-DRIFT-1) — the running DeepChat app persists preferredModel/defaultModel in the Roaming `app_dbgent.db` `app_settings` rows (`value_json` = `"<provider>/<model>"` string form) and RE-WRITES `app-settings.json` from them on save; a JSON-only reset of the model keys is reverted by the next app save (canonical 2026-08-28 closeout: E4 reverted to QNFO-ROUTER/ensemble three times despite JSON fix). Fix MUST align the DB rows too: `UPDATE app_settings SET value_json='"deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash"' WHERE key IN ('preferredModel','defaultModel')` in Roaming app_db agent.db, THEN the JSON files, THEN read-back BOTH stores. Root-cause per RECURRENCE-ZERO-1: the DB is the persistence source, not the symptom.
> (2) [HARD] **D1-QUERY-BEARER-FALLBACK-1** — when the d1_database_query tool is unavailable mid-session (vanished once in the 2026-08-28 weekly review), query D1 directly via the Cloudflare API: `curl -X POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{acct}/d1/database/{db_id}/query -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /c/Users/LENOVO/tokens/cloudflare)" -d '{"sql":"..."}'`. The `tokens/cloudflare` file is a `cfat_...` API token usable as Bearer (NOT X-Auth-Key — that returns Authentication error; the file is not a JSON keypair). Canonical: 2026-08-28 handoffs/wbs_state inserts via Bearer fallback.
> Cross-reference: kaizen v2.111, cloudflare v3.67, qnfo-core v1.36, research v2.143 (unchanged), session this.

> **v3.90 UPDATE (2026-08-28, kaizen — CMD SKILLS UPDATE: weekly-review triage gates — GRAPH-SYNC-BULK-ONLY-1 + CONSOLIDATION-TARGET-AUDIT-1 + REGISTRY-LAG-PARITY-1 + ENUMERATION-DRIFT-SNAPSHOT-1; mirrors kaizen v2.110 + cloudflare v3.66 + qnfo-core v1.36 + research v2.143 unchanged):**
> Red-team: Accuracy + Dependency subagents PASS-WITH-NITS (patience honored ~15 min per REDTEAM-QUEUE-STALL-PATIENCE-1); Completeness child FAILED → direct fallback audit per REDTEAM-CHILD-FAIL-1 — 1 HARD catch fixed (stale Radix duplicate ARCHIVED). HARD: 4 (new gates). Changes:
> (1) [HARD] **GRAPH-SYNC-BULK-ONLY-1** — POST graph-api.qnfo.org/sync accepts EXACTLY `{"action":"bulk","nodes":[{"id","name","label","properties"}],"edges":[]}` (contract documented in cloudflare skill F-6, 2026-07-25); ANY other body shape returns the unhelpful `{"error":"Only bulk sync supported"}` — read the documented contract from the skill BEFORE probing the endpoint. Batch ≤50 nodes/call; nodes upsert via ON CONFLICT(id). Canonical: 2026-08-28 weekly review — five wrong-shape probes before reading F-6.
> (2) [HARD] **CONSOLIDATION-TARGET-AUDIT-1** — when a node carries `consolidated_into: <target>`, the TARGET must be dispositioned too; a consolidated node pointing at an already-archived target is a stale duplicate remnant (the 08-16 sweep archived radix-uw-bt but MISSED the deprecated "Radix-Ultrametric-BruhatTits Synthesis" DRAFT node that consolidated into it — caught by the 2026-08-28 red team, ARCHIVED + read-back verified).
> (3) [HARD] **REGISTRY-LAG-PARITY-1** — D1 program_registry status can LAG living-paper (RES.026 `active` vs living-paper `published`); when a paper is published update BOTH stores same-cycle; before claiming published verify program_registry + living-paper + Zenodo agree (canonical fix 2026-08-28: RES.026 → published, read-back verified).
> (4) [HARD] **ENUMERATION-DRIFT-SNAPSHOT-1** — full-corpus Project-node enumeration counts DRIFT under concurrent sessions (158 enumerated → 159/160 at audit); record snapshot semantics — dispositioned nodes are verified by ID (7/7 read-back), count drift is concurrent-session churn not a review error; never drop a disposition because the total moved.
> Cross-reference: kaizen v2.110, cloudflare v3.66, qnfo-core v1.36, research v2.143 (unchanged), session this.

> **v3.89 UPDATE (2026-08-28, kaizen — CMD SKILLS UPDATE: QNFO Router endpoint anti-generic + worker deploy-revert discipline — QNFO-ROUTER-DEFAULT-PROMPT-1 + CONTINUATION-CONTEXT-INJECTION-1 + WORKER-FALLBACK-TEXT-1 + WORKER-API-DEPLOY-REVERT-1 + WORKER-UPLOAD-FILENAME-1 + CHATBOX-CLIENT-PARITY-1; mirrors kaizen v2.109 + cloudflare v3.65 + qnfo-core v1.36 + research v2.143 unchanged):**
> Red-team: direct parent-agent audit (session this — Chatbox↔DeepChat parity + qnfo-ai endpoint generic-filler fix; reviewer children queue-then-complete per REDTEAM-QUEUE-STALL-1). HARD: 5 (new gates) + 1 SOFT. Changes:
> (1) [HARD] **QNFO-ROUTER-DEFAULT-PROMPT-1** — the qnfo-ai worker's `DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT` (injected for a bare request with no client system message) MUST carry anti-generic + QNFO-identity + never-fabricate rules. A bare prompt from ANY client (Chatbox, the playground PWA, or a raw API call) must never return generic filler ("I'm happy to continue our conversation", "what's on your mind?", "I can suggest some options", suggestion menus) or a hollow "QNFO definition not confirmed" report. The fix lives at the ENDPOINT (worker), not the client — client-side default prompts are necessary but not sufficient (they only apply when the client sends a system message). Canonical: qnfo-ai 2026-08-28 — three recurrences of generic filler traced to the worker's weak default prompt.
> (2) [HARD] **CONTINUATION-CONTEXT-INJECTION-1** — a bare continuation (CONTINUE / WHAT'S NEXT? / YOU TELL ME... / go on / resume / proceed / keep going / next) with a single user message MUST inject the recent logged activity (D1 `ai_queries`, `ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20`, filtering out the continuation prompts themselves) as system context, so "CONTINUE" returns real recent-work status — never a static mission statement alone and never a fabricated continuation.
> (3) [HARD] **WORKER-FALLBACK-TEXT-1** — a worker's empty-output fallback (`"All models failed."`) MUST be a substantive state message (identity + mission + programs + "rephrase or retry"), never a cryptic error. Free tier-0 models (glm-5.2 etc.) occasionally return empty content for ultra-short prompts — the fallback must still deliver useful QNFO state.
> (4) [HARD] **WORKER-API-DEPLOY-REVERT-1** — a Workers-API-only deploy (editing the deployed bundle via `PUT /accounts/{id}/workers/scripts/{name}`, without committing to the worker's repo) is REVERTED by the next repo-based `wrangler deploy`. The durable fix is committing the change to the repo. Extends WORKER-EDIT-BASE-VERIFY-1. Canonical: 2026-08-28 — the qnfo-ai endpoint fix (v5.2.4/v5.2.5, API-only) was reverted by a concurrent session's v5.3.0 repo deploy (weak prompt + "All models failed." restored) the same day; the exact risk was flagged at closeout and then materialized.
> (5) [HARD] **WORKER-UPLOAD-FILENAME-1** — the Workers API module upload multipart requires `filename="worker.js"` on the module part (`Content-Disposition: form-data; name="worker.js"; filename="worker.js"`); omitting it → HTTP 10021 "No such module: worker.js". Extract the bundle between `var __defProp` and `//# sourceMappingURL=worker.js.map`; PUT metadata = `{main_module:"worker.js", compatibility_date, compatibility_flags, usage_model, bindings:[non-secret only — secret_text persists separately]}`.
> (6) [SOFT] **CHATBOX-CLIENT-PARITY-1** — Chatbox (a parallel client to DeepChat) re-fetches `/v1/models` for custom OpenAI providers and can shrink `settings.providers[provider].models` (observed 16→2 once; the canonical list lives in `customProviders[].defaultSettings.models`). `autoLaunch` requires the HKCU Run registry entry (`"C:\Program Files\Chatbox\Chatbox.exe"`) — the config key alone reverts on restart. The anti-generic lever is `settings.defaultPrompt` (there is NO per-model prompt field in the provider schema). Keep the worker's model list and Chatbox's list aligned after any worker model change.
> Cross-reference: kaizen v2.109, cloudflare v3.65, qnfo-core v1.36, research v2.143 (unchanged), session this.
